description: This Java source file defines the PolicyEntryModifiedStrategy class, which handles PolicyEntryModified events within the policy persistence framework of the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements the applyEvent method to update a PolicyBuilder with data from the event.

classes.name: PolicyEntryModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyEventStrategy for handling PolicyEntryModified events. It updates a policy builder with the policy entry from the event.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to apply a PolicyEntryModified event to a PolicyBuilder by setting its policy entry.
